channelMetadataRenderer.title: Electronics DIY channel
channelMetadataRenderer.description:
Welcome to my YouTube channel! I am a maker at heart and I love to explore the world of embedded systems. On this channel, you will find videos where I document my journey learning Arduino and other embedded systems. From basic tutorials to more advanced projects, I share everything I learn along the way.

Join me as I dive into the exciting world of electronics and programming. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced maker, there's something here for everyone. So, hit that subscribe button and let's start creating together!
